The '''Sluis Van Outer Starfighter Base''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military]] installation located near [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]]<ref name="tdc" /> in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA-OC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Although primarily used as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base, flight instruction was also undertaken at the installation. [[Noell Ciro]], a trainee from the planet [[Dolomar]], underwent [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] training at the Sluis Van Outer Starfighter Base, qualifying for active military service in the [[New Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|New Republic Starfighter Corps]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="tdc" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sluis Van Outer Starfighter Base was referenced in Noell Ciro's biography in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]].
